symptom: describe of a Java/JavaScript action, or the Java EXTRA CODE retained on a rewrite, is cut one or more bytes off (`E\nreturn true` for `return true;`) when a character above the markers changes byte length under case folding (U+0130 'İ', the Kelvin sign)
cause: sliceBetweenFold searched strings.ToLower(s) and used those indices to slice s; ToLower is not length-preserving for all runes
fix: fold ASCII only (the markers are ASCII), so offsets in the folded copy are offsets in s
insight: An index into strings.ToLower(s) is not an index into s; use an ASCII fold or strings.EqualFold on windows when slicing the original
